Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:1.hebrew: של אמש - מיין ששפה אמש ונשארו השמרים, אין מערבין אותו ביין ששפה היום, ששמרי יין זה מקלקלין יין אחר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:1.english: Of the night before - From wine that he poured the night before and the lees remained, one may not mix it with wine that he poured today, for the lees of this wine spoil another wine.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:2.hebrew: אבל נותן הוא לו את שמריו - של יין עצמו. ויום ואמש לאו דוקא, והוא הדין ליום ויום משתי חביות, אלא אורחא דמילתא נקט, דסתם יום ואמש משתי חביות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:2.english: But he may give him its sediment - [The sediment] of the wine itself. And "day" and "the night before" are not meant strictly, as the same law applies to [wine of] day and day from two [different] casks; rather, it [merely] speaks of the usual case, since ordinarily [wine of] the day and [of] the night before are from two [different] casks.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:3.hebrew: השופה יין - כל דבר הצלול הנזרק בנחת מכלי אל כלי, שלא יתערבו בו שמרים, קרו לה שפייה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:10:3.english: One who pours wine - Any clear thing that is poured gently from vessel to vessel, so that sediment will not mix into it, they call it shefiyah.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:1.hebrew: מזגיה - נתן בו מים, שכן דרכו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:1.english: He diluted it - He put water into it, for such was his custom.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:3.hebrew: והא אנן תנן ולא לתגר שאינו אלא לרמות כו' - וחנווני היינו תגר, ויחזור חנווני זה וימכרנו בחזקת יין בחנות, והרי המים מעורבין בו, ואתה מכרת לו, ואיכא לפני עור (ויקרא יט):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:3.english: But didn't we learn: And not to a merchant, for [he only buys it] to deceive, etc. - Now a storekeeper is [the same as] a merchant, and this storekeeper will turn around and sell it under the presumption of [pure] wine in the store, while water is mixed into it, and you sold [it] to him, so there is [a violation of] "Before a blind person" (Leviticus 19).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:4.english: My dilution is evident - For I put a lot of water in it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:5.english: And if you say [that] he will bring undiluted wine and mix [it] with it - until the taste of the water is not noticeable.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:6.hebrew: א"כ - דלכולי האי חיישינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:6.english: If so - That we are concerned to such an extent.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:7.hebrew: אין לדבר סוף - שאף המים לבדם אסור למכור לחנווני, שמא יערבם ביין, ולא חשו אלא בזמן שאני מוכר לו דבר העשוי לרמות בו כמות שהוא עכשיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:11:7.english: There is no end to the matter - For [then] even water by itself would be forbidden to sell to a storekeeper, lest he mix it with wine; and [the Sages] were only concerned when I sell him something suited for deceit as it is right now.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:12:1.hebrew: למחצה לשליש ולרביע - הכל כמנהג המדינה יטיל מים. אם מחצה — מחצה, אם שליש — שליש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:12:1.english: For one-half, for one-third, and for one-fourth - Everything [follows] the local custom [when] he adds water: if [it is] one-half, [he adds] one-half; if [it is] one-third, [he adds] one-third.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:13:1.hebrew: ולא יפחות את השער - למכור בזול, מפני שמרגיל לבא אצלו ומקפח מזונות חבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:13:1.english: And one may not reduce the [market] rate - [Meaning,] to sell cheaply, because he accustoms [customers] to come to him and curtails his fellow's livelihood.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:13:2.english: Remembered for good - For through this, hoarders of produce sell cheaply.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:1.hebrew: גריסין - פולין גרוסות בריחים, אחת לשתים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:1.english: Ground beans - Beans ground in a mill, [each] one into two.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:2.hebrew: לא יבור את הפסולת - לפי שמתוך שנראות יפות, הוא מעלה על דמיהם הרבה מדמי הפסולת שנטל מהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:2.english: He may not sift out the refuse - Because since [the beans] appear attractive, he raises their price by much more than the value of the refuse that he removed from them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:3.english: And the Sages permit [it] - The reason is explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:4.hebrew: ומודים שלא יבור מעל פי המגורה - למעלה, להראות יפות, ואת הפסולת שבתוכו לא בירר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:4.english: And they concede that one may not sift from the opening of the bin - [That is,] on top, to make [them] appear good, while the refuse inside it he did not sift out.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:5.english: Because it is nothing other than deceiving the eye - With this sifting.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:6.english: And one may not adorn - [This is] explained in the Gemara.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:14:7.english: Not a person - A Canaanite slave who is about to be sold.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:16:1.english: What is the reason - [that they] used [the phrase] "remembered for good," an expression of blessing?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:1:1.hebrew: ואין צ"ל חדשים בישנים - פסק למכור לו ישנים, לא יערב בהן חדשים, שהישנים יבישים ועושין קמח יותר מן החדשים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:1:1.english: And needless to say, new [produce] with old [produce] - [If] he contracted to sell him old [produce], he may not mix new [produce] into them, because the old [produce] are dry and yield more flour than the new [produce].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:2:1.hebrew: מפני שמשביחו - קשה משביח את הרך, לפיכך פסק עמו רך, מערב בו קשה. ודוקא קתני קשה ברך ולא רך בקשה: פסק עמו קשה, לא יערב בו את הרך. וכן אין צריך לומר חדשים בישנים דוקא, אבל ישנים בחדשים שפיר דמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:2:1.english: Because it enhances it - Strong [wine] enhances weak [wine]; therefore, [if] he stipulated with him [to sell] weak [wine], he may mix strong [wine] into it. And [the Mishnah] specifically taught "strong into weak," and not "weak into strong": [if] he stipulated with him [to sell] strong [wine], he may not mix the weak [wine] into it. And similarly, [the Mishnah's statement] "it goes without saying new [produce] into old" [is] specifically [so], but old [produce] into new is perfectly fine.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:2:2.english: One may not mix wine sediment with wine - In the Gemara, [it] explains it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:1.english: He may sell it in the store - [selling it] a perutah's worth at a time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:2.hebrew: אלא א"כ הודיעו - לכל אחד ואחד מהן, שמים מעורבין בו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:2.english: Unless he informs him - To each and every one of them, that water is mixed in it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:3.hebrew: ולא לתגר - ימכרנו ביחד, ואף על פי שמודיעו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:3.english: And not to a merchant - He may [not] sell it all together, even though he informs him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:4.english: Because he only buys it to deceive - and to sell it in a store.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:5.hebrew: מקום שנהגו להטיל מים ביין יטילו - דכיון שנהגו, אין כאן טעות, שכל היינות בחזקת כן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:3:5.english: [In] a place where they are accustomed to place water into wine, they may place [it] - For since they are accustomed [to do so], there is no mistake here, as all wines are presumed [to be] so.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:1.hebrew: התגר נוטל מחמש גרנות וכו' - שהכל יודעין בו שלא גדלו בשדותיו, ומבני אדם הרבה לוקח, ובחזקת כן לוקחין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:1.english: A merchant takes from five threshing floors, etc. - For everyone knows about him that [the crops] did not grow in his fields, and [that] he buys from many people, and on that presumption they buy [from him].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:2.hebrew: מגורה - אוצר שאוצרין בו תבואה. גורן הוא שדשין וזורין בו את התבואה, ודרך התגר לקנות מבעלי בתים בשעת הגורן ולהכניס למגורה שלו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:2.english: Warehouse - [This is] a storehouse in which grain is stored. A threshing floor is [a place] where they thresh and winnow the grain, and it is the practice of a merchant to buy from landowners at threshing time and bring [it] into his warehouse.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:3.hebrew: שלא יתכוין לערב - ולהוציא קול, לקנות הרוב ממקום משובח לערב בו ממקום אחר, ושכיניו סבורין שכל הפירות מאותו מקום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:4:3.english: [Provided] that he does not intend to mix - and to spread a rumor [by] buying the majority [of his produce] from a superior place to mix into it [produce] from another place, while his neighbors think that all the produce is from that [same] place.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:1.hebrew: ת"ר אין צריך לומר חדשות מארבע - סאין בסלע:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:1.english: The Sages taught: Needless to say, new [produce] at four - se'ah for a sela.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:2.english: And old [produce] at three - se’a for a sela.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:3.hebrew: דאין מערבין - חדשות בישנות, דהואיל ובחזקת ישנות מוכרן, נמצא מאנהו ומוכר לו זולות בתורת יקרות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:3.english: That one may not intermingle - new [produce] with old [produce]; for since he sells them under the presumption of [being] old [produce], he is thereby defrauding him and selling him inexpensive [produce] as expensive [produce].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:4.hebrew: אלא אפי' חדשות משלש וישנות מארבע אין מערבין - ואע"פ שהחדשות יקרות מהן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:4.english: Rather, even [if] new [produce is] at three [se'ah per sela] and old [produce is] at four, one may not mix [them] - Even though the new [produce] is more expensive than they [are].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:5.hebrew: מפני שאדם רוצה לישנן - מפני שעילוי דמיהן של חדשות אינן מפני שהן טובות כישנות, אלא שאדם רוצה לישנן. וזה שפסק עמו על הישנות אינו רוצה לישנן, לפיכך אסור לערב בהו חדשות, ואפי' מעולות בדמים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:5:5.english: Because a person wants to age them - Because the higher price of the new [produce] is not because they are as good as the old [produce], rather [it is] because a person wants to age them. And this [buyer] who contracted with him for the old [produce] does not want to age them; therefore, it is forbidden to mix new [produce] into them, even [though they are] higher in price.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:6:1.hebrew: עדא אמרה - זאת אומרת. כל עדא כמו הדא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:6:1.english: Ada amrah - That is to say. Every [instance of] "ada" is like "hada" [meaning "this"].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:6:2.hebrew: באמת הלכ' - מדיהב טעם למילתי' מפני שמשביחו ואין לגמגם בדבר, ונקט בה למתניתין באמת, ש"מ כל היכא דתני באמת, הלכה, ואין לחסם ולגמגם בדבר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:6:2.english: Actually, [it is] a halakha - Since [the Tanna] gave a reason for his statement — because it enhances it and there is no [reason] to hesitate about the matter — and [still] used the word "actually" in the Mishnah, learn from this [that] wherever it teaches "actually," [it is an established] halakha, and one must not object or hesitate about the matter.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:7:1.hebrew: ובין הגיתות שנו - דמשביחו, שתוססין זה עם זה ונעשים טעם אחד. אבל לאחר הגיתות, שכבר קלט כל אחד ריחו וטעמו, אין משביחו אלא פוגמו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:7:1.english: And among the winepresses they taught [this] - For it improves it, as they ferment with one another and become a single flavor. However, after [the season of] the winepresses, when each one has already acquired its own aroma and taste, it does not improve it, but rather impairs it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:8:1.english: Because they know - Everyone knows that they are presumed to mix [wine].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:8:2.english: In a matter that is tasted - [Something] that a person tastes before he buys it, and can discern that [something] was mixed into it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:9:1.hebrew: והא מדקתני סיפא - ומפליג בין הודיעו ללא הודיעו, מכלל דרישא דקתני "אבל נותן לו את שמריו", אע"ג דלא אודעיה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 60a:9:1.english: And from [the fact] that the latter clause teaches - and distinguishes between [where] he informed him and [where] he did not inform him, it may be inferred that the former clause, which teaches "but he may give him its sediment," [applies] even though he did not inform him.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:11:1.hebrew: רבא אייתו ליה חמרא - "רבא" גרסינן, דאשכחן שהיתה מזיגתו משונה, כדאמרינן בנדרים (דף נה.) ובכיצד מעברין (עירובין דף נד.): "דמיא האי מזיגא למזגא דרבא בריה דרב יוסף בר (חייא)". והשתא ניחא הא דאמר רבא בפרק המוציא יין (שבת דף עז. ושם ד"ה דאמר): "כל חמרא דלא דרי על חד תלת מיא לאו חמרא הוא". ובפרק אחד דיני ממונות (סנהדרין לז.) אמרינן: "אל יחסר המזג" — שאם הוצרכו מהם לצאת, אם יש שם כ"ג כנגד סנהדרי קטנה יוצאים, ואם לאו אין יוצאים; משמע דמזיגה על חד תרי דקרא [איירי] במזיגת סתם בני אדם. ומיהו קשה, דמשמע התם דס"ל לרבא דעיקר מזיגה כך דינה, דמוקי מתני' דבמזוג ב' חלקים מים ואחד יין ביין השרוני דוקא דרפי. ונראה דרבא מוקי מזיגה דקרא ד"אל יחסר המזג" ביין השרוני. והרב מנחם מיוני פירש ד"אל יחסר המזג" — שלא יחסרו נ' מסנהדרי גדולה, דמזג בגימ' נ'; אבל אם יחסר מ"ט, ישארו כ"ב, ואין ב"ד שקול, מוסיפין עליהם אחד — הרי כ"ג. ומיהו בירושלמי משמע דאיירי במזיגת יין ממש:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:11:1.english: They brought wine to Rava - We read the text as "Rava," for we find that his dilution [of wine] was unusual, as we say in Nedarim (55a) and in [the chapter] Keitzad Me'abrin (Eruvin 54a): "This dilution resembles the dilution of Rava, son of Rav Yosef bar (Chiyya)." And now that which Rava said in the chapter HaMotzi Yayin (Shabbat 77a, and there s.v. de'amar) is well-understood: "Any wine that cannot carry three parts water to one [part wine] is not wine." And in the chapter Echad Dinei Mamonot (Sanhedrin 37a), we say: "Let not the mixed wine (hamezeg) be lacking" — for if some of them need to leave, if there are twenty-three [remaining] corresponding to the small Sanhedrin, they may leave, and if not, they may not leave; this implies that the dilution of one to two [i.e., one part wine to two parts water] of the verse [refers] to the dilution of ordinary people. However, it is difficult, for it implies there that Rava holds that the primary dilution has this law [of one to three], since he establishes the Mishnah regarding [wine] diluted with two parts water and one [part] wine as referring specifically to Sharon wine, which is weak. And it seems that Rava establishes the dilution of the verse "Let not the mixed wine be lacking" as referring to Sharon wine. And Rabbi Menachem of Joigny explained "Let not the mixed wine be lacking" — that fifty should not be lacking from the Great Sanhedrin, for mezeg in gematria is fifty; however, if forty-nine are lacking, twenty-two remain, and since a court cannot be even-numbered, they add one to them — making twenty-three. However, in the Yerushalmi it implies that [the verse] refers to actual dilution of wine.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:1:1.hebrew: ואין צ"ל חדשים בישנים - משום דאמר בפ' המוכר את הספינה (ב"ב דף צא:), דכל מילי עתיקי מעלו, בר מתמרי, שיכרא והרסנא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:1:1.english: And needless to say, new [produce] with old [produce] - Because [the Gemara] states in the chapter [entitled] HaMokher Et HaSefinah (Bava Batra 91b) that all old things are superior, except for dates, beer, and harsana [small fried fish].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:9:1.hebrew: [מאי] (אבל) נותן לו שמריו דקמודע ליה - דס"ד דאפ"ה אסור, שלא ירמה בו אחרים:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 60a:9:1.english: [What is] (but) "he gives him its sediment"? That he informs him - For you might have thought that even so, it is forbidden, lest he [the buyer] deceive others with it.
